title: Space scientist David W. Webb and government awareness of abductions

tellings.quote: Uh I was aware by then uh that there were people inside the government who had had a certain amount of contact because I had met uh a space scientist David W. web

plain: Whitley Strieber, an author who has written about his own experiences of being taken by unknown beings at his cabin in upstate New York, says that by the mid-1980s he knew some people inside the government had had contact. He knew it, he tells Michels, because he had met a space scientist named David W. Webb, and he mentions the UFO researcher Stanton Friedman in the same account. If true, it means officials knew about such encounters well before the public did.
